newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Huangshan A share issue approved.
newsitem.headline: Huangshan A share issue approved.

text.p: Shanghai Huangshan Tourism Development Co said on Friday its plan to make an offer of 40 million A shares had been approved by securities authorities, a company official said.

The firm will issue 37.5 million shares on the Shanghai stock exchange in early April after the China Securities Regulatory Commission approved the plan on Thursday, the official told the Hong Kong-based newsletter China Securities Bulletin.
The remaining 2.5 million A shares will be allocated among employees, he said.
The company, which listed 80 million B shares in Shanghai last November, plans to price the A shares between six and seven yuan, the official said.
Earlier, a company official said proceeds would be used to renovate the Huangshan Hotel in the eastern province of Anhui.
The firm had named Anhui Provincial Securities Co as the lead underwriter for the A share issue, he said.

The firm estimated that its 1996 post-tax profit could top 65 million yuan under international accounting standards with earnings per share being at around 0.364 yuan, he said. The company has yet to post 1996 results.
In its B share prospectus, Huangshan Tourism said it had net profits of 43.31 million yuan in 1995 and 29.22 million yuan the previous year under international standards.
